articles.title: Sprites List (Chapter 7 Season 4) - Fortnite Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Thought Sprite hunting was over with the end of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3? Think again - they're back in Override and are a major part of Chapter 7
articles.body:
Thought Sprite hunting was over with the end of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3? Think again - they're back in Override and are a major part of Chapter 7 Season 4. There are currently 162 Sprites to collect, each with its own ability that affects your gameplay. This IGN guide teaches you everything you need to know about Sprites in Fortnite CH7S4, including all variants, rarities, and effects, plus tips on how to extract them safely. Use our Sprites Checklist to track your collection!

All Sprites in Fortnite Override - Sprite Checklist

There are currently 162 Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, including 27 base Sprites plus variants. Use our checklist below to track your exact progress toward collecting and Mastering them all:

Overshield Sprite Rare Grants Overshield, with more per level Overshield Sprite

Onigiri Sprite Rare Grants Overdrive after using a Consumable item, lasting longer per level Onigiri Sprite

Storm Scout Sprite Rare Grants the Overdrive effect after taking a certain amount of storm damage. At max level, it reveals future Storm Circles. Storm Scout Sprite

8-Bit Sprite Rare Gives you an 8-Bit Shotgun in your first chest and grants a score multiplier. 8-Bit Sprite

Bush Sprite Rare Puts a Bush on you after a duration. At level 5, you'll gain a Bush after eliminations. Bush Sprite

Adventure Sprite Rare Upgrades a random item in your inventory each time you level it up. Adventure Sprite

Jonesy Sprite Rare Slowly recovers some Health and Shield for a short duration after taking damage. Jonesy Sprite

Birthday Sprite Rare Gives you a chance to receive a piece of cake when opening chests. Birthday Sprite

Sonic Sprite Epic Increases Sprint speed Sonic Sprite

Tails Sprite Epic Allows you to hover for a short duration Tails Sprite

Shadow Sprite Epic Automatically reloads your weapons over time, even when unequipped Shadow Sprite

Pond Sprite Epic Grants you a Super Jump after jumping, with more charges gained over time. Super Jump strength increases with each level. Pond Sprite

Morgana Sprite Epic Increases effectiveness of healing items, which increases with each level. Morgana Sprite

Dumpster Dive Sprite Epic Buffs heals from food and gives you a chance to find food when jumping out of dumpsters and porta potties and opening containers, with better food chance with each level. Dumpster Dive Sprite

Killswitch Sprite Legendary Grants Hangtime effect with improved accuracy. Hangtime puts you into a midair, slow motion animation which improves your aim and removes weapon bloom. Killswitch Sprite

Jackrabbit Sprite Legendary Allows you to double-jump. Jackrabbit Sprite

X-Ray Sprite Legendary Periodically marks nearby enemies. Frequency and radius increases with each level. X-Ray Sprite

Blinky Sprite Legendary Grants you Cloak when you take damage, which increases with each level. Blinky Sprite

Crash Bandicoot Sprite Legendary Jump to trigger a whirlwind attack, which damages and knocks back enemies. Damage increases with each level. Crash Bandicoot Sprite

Vampire Sprite Legendary Heals you when you damage enemies. Amount healed increases per level. Vampire Sprite

The Deer Sprite Legendary Buffs melee damage, which increases per level. The Deer Sprite

Klombo Sprite Mythic Drops random items at each level. It can only be leveled up by using consumables that grant Health or Shield. Klombo Sprite

Spooky Dash Sprite Mythic Grants you a dash that lets you phase through objects and walls. Each level reduces cooldown. Spooky Dash Sprite

Crown Sprite Mythic Grants extra Crown Wins after winning a Victory Royale. It can only be leveled up by winning matches and new variants are also unlocked by mastering it. Crown Sprite

Mega Man Sprite Rare Allows you to slide around like Mega Man, with slide length increased per level Mega Man Sprite

One Wish Willow Sprite Mythic Extract other players equipped Sprites when eliminating them. Push everything away when damaged. Gets upset when removed and marks you on the map. One Wish Willow Sprite

Honey Sprite Epic Chance to spawn bees at the hit location upon dealing damage with a ranged weapon Honey Sprite

Like the previous season, most Sprites have Special variants with an additional effect. These variants are rarer than their base counterparts and therefore more desirable. Variants include:

Cheat Master : Allows you to press any button when inputting Cheat Codes.

Loot Hacker : Increases chance of spawning items from your Loot Hacks.

Bounty Hunter : Chance for a Sprite will drop when getting an elimination.

Trick or Treat : Chance for candy to drop when you open containers.

Following player feedback from Season 3, Epic Games has added the following Sprite quality-of-life changes in CH7S4:

It now indicates when you've collected a Sprite previously and shows the name of a Sprite when you're near it.

The button-hold time for summoning a Sprite has been reduced.

As far as we're aware, there are no Sprites that are currently in the game's files but that are still unreleased.

Epic Games has confirmed that some Sprites from Season 3 "may" return later on in Season 4, though have yet to reveal which ones. We'll update this guide once we know more.

Once a Sprite reaches level 5 and you extract it, it becomes Mastered. The more Sprites you Master, the more additional rewards you earn, including Portable Extractors, Sprite Dust, XP, and rare Sprite variants.

Here are all the Sprite Mastery rewards, plus checkmarks so you can track what you've unlocked so far:

How to Extract Sprites - Tips and Tricks

To add a Sprite to your collection, you must extract it. There are three ways to extract Sprites:

Win a match with a Sprite equipped or in your inventory

The easiest and safest way to extract is to use a Portable Extractor, accessed via the Gizmo wheel. This allows you to extract a Sprite wherever you are, meaning you don't need to visit an Extraction Site. You can get more Portable Extractors from certain Daily Quests, or from the Sprite Dust Services Terminal at an Extraction Site.

You can purchase one Portable Extractor per day from a Sprite Dust Services terminal. Because new Sprites are being added constantly and it's random which ones will appear in your match, we recommend carving out five minutes each day to log in and buy your daily Portable Extractor - that way, you always have one when you need it. If you do need to use an Extraction Site, calling the crate will alert nearby players while you wait for it to drop. The best way to combat this is to use an Extraction Accelerator Gizmo, which drops the crate almost instantly, meaning you don't have to run and hide.

You obtain these via certain Daily Quests, and you can get two by entering the "TakeYourHeart" Admin Panel code. When trying to Master a Sprite, it's safer to extract it every level or so, rather than trying to get it level 5 in a single match. There's nothing worse than having a level 4 Sprite and then getting eliminated before you have the chance to Master and extract it. When this happens, it'll reset back to level 1, meaning you need to start all over again.

This is particularly true for harder-to-Master Sprites such as Klombo, which only gain XP when using certain consumable items like Shield Potions and Flopper fish. The slow and steady approach works best; while more time-consuming, it's so much less risky.

Some Sprites can be obtained via Admin Panel codes! Head to our Fortnite Lobby Hack Codes and Rewards guide for the full list .

Need more help with Sprites? Check out these Override guides:

articles.title: Weapons List and Locations - Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Guide - IGN
articles.summary: With a plethora of putrid enemies to destroy on your path to killing Dracula, Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse gives protagonist Rose plenty of tools for
articles.body:
With a plethora of putrid enemies to destroy on your path to killing Dracula, Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse gives protagonist Rose plenty of tools for the job. Yes, there’s a whip, but for players hoping to try different combat styles, there is actually a wide selection of weapons, broken down into a few distinct categories. So for those hoping to find and unlock every weapon on offer, follow this full Armoury guide and then get back to slaying vampires with a shiny new tool of destruction.

Below you'll find locations for all the different Weapons in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, divided up by weapon type. Each weapon type has four rarities, increasing damage by 25 each rarity to a maximum of 100, and each weapon type also has a particular moveset and mechanics unique to that type.

The Longsword is Rose Belmont's default weapon, and is available to her from the very start of the game.

Location: Paris Streets: Justice District Sewers

From the Paris Streets: Court of Justice, travel to the bottom right exit, just to the right of the red door. After entering the docks, drop down through the platform, and slide through the small entrance on the bottom left.

Travel left to the Justice District Sewers, and drop down again, before using Holy Light to drop through the stone.

Swing to the left, timing it so you are situated between the two blades as you swing.

On the other side of the two stone pillars, swing with your whip to activate a switch.

Then swing back to the two stone pillars while holding Holy Light, then release it to bounce off the solid stone pillars and rise up above.

Then, with the platform lowered, swing on the Whip hooks above to reach the chest in the top right part of the room.

Where to Find the Joyeuse: Directions Coming Soon!

Where to Find the Valmanway: Directions Coming Soon!

A one-handed sword combined with a shield. Allows Rose to block attacks.

Location: Holy Innocents Cemetery: Serpents' Lair

Where to Find the Rusted Harpe and Aegis:

After defeating Medusa at the Serpent’s Lair, move through the exit on the right, and you will find the Rusted Harpe and Aegis at the bottom of the steps.

Enter the Library: Condemned Shelves from the middle entrance on the left side of the room, and you will be confronted with a large globe surrounded by floating orbs.

Move to the right-hand side of the room, dispose of enemies, and use the right-hand ledge to jump up to the platform at the same level as the globe.

Bounce on the bottom four glowing orbs specifically - without touching the others - to reveal an additional, larger glowing orb above the globe.

Bounce directly upwards on this new orb to reveal a secret area.

Continue bouncing upwards on the orbs, then use Aerial Rush to dash to the left, and Holy Light to pass through the stones.

Through to the next orbs on the left, bounce up once again, land on the right-hand platform without using Holy Light to gain purchase, then launch left while holding Holy Light and again use Aerial Rush to dash across to the leftmost part of this passage.

Once through to the left side of the passage - directly above the candlestick - simply drop straight down to find the chest.

Required Abilities: Aerial Rush, Holy Light

A two-handed weapon that can reach farther than other weapons.

From the Holy Innocents' Cemetery, move to the left of the fountain and start to rise up the large staircase.

At the top of the staircase is a room with a switch; head inside and hit the switch to begin a battle with several enemies.

Defeat those enemies, and move to the right to see a newly revealed wall, allowing you to double jump and reach above this room.

Jump between the existing wall and the newly revealed wall to reach above the room.

From here, move left to unveil the chest.

Location: Clock Tower: Mechanic's Ascent

Brass Knuckles are close-combat weapons that deal increased damage the more you launch sustained attacks.

Location: Paris Streets: Sewer Reservoir

From the base of the Paris Streets' Tower, specifically the Guard Level, move to the right.

Continue left until you see a grate, and then press the jump button while holding Down to pass through the grate below Rose.

On this lower level, smash the statue on the left, then move right and slide to sneak through the hidden passage.

Then, head to the grate on the right-hand side and once again drop down.

Jump across the wooden platforms to reach the chest on the left-hand side of this large room.

Opening the chest will then bring up the walls around this room, and several enemies will attack. Defeat them to escape with the new Cestus weapon.

From the Mirror Room in the Main Hall: Archives, exit through the right-hand door.

Use the whip to attach to and enter the floating mirror just above the entrance you just passed through.

Jump diagonally up and right to reach the floating wooden platform, while avoiding the moving buzzsaws.

From the wooden platform, quickly whip to the right and enter this second painting before the wooden platform crumbles.

Fire Rose out from the painting to the candlelit platform to the right. This platform will not crumble.

Use the whip to enter the next painting, above the candlelit platform.

Fire Rose out of the painting diagonally to the right and upwards. Importantly, the painting is swaying slight from left to right, so make sure to fire Rose while the painting is at the left-most part of its journey, to avoid firing Rose into the buzzsaw.

Once over, quickly land on the crumbling wooden platform and then jump to your right to drop down to another platform situated below.

Avoiding the buzzsaws, drop down to the corridor below with the red carpet. Then, start moving to the right, and then drop through the grate just below the pink anchor point.

In the next room, move left, and drop through another grate. Then, move to the right.

Either avoiding the enemy with the lance, or killing them, clib the staircase and enter this new room on the right-hand side.

In this new room, drop through the grate in the center to reach the new red door, and then enter the door.

Upon reaching the other side of the red door, jump up to hit the switch above Rose.

Then, with the walls next to the chest now down, Rose can move to the right and open it.

The large two-handed Greatswords are incredibly slow, but pack a large hit and can be spun in the air or charged on ground for a follow-up strike.

Location: Paris Streets - Roof of the Tower

Where to Find the Burnt Sword of Fierbois: Directions Coming Soon!

Where to Find Durandal: Directions Coming Soon!

Long dual swords can be used to quickly strike out with rapid spinning attacks, and can be chained after the first swing completes for a devestating follow-up blitz.

Location: Catacombs Of Paris - Crossroads Of The Dead

Where to Find the Pair of Longswords: Directions Coming Soon!

Where to Find the Rapiers: Directions Coming Soon!

The classic Vampire Hunter weapon returns, featuring the ability to deploy long-ranged strikes in any directions, and deals the brunt of its damage at the tip of the weapon's strike!

Location: Catacombs Of Paris - Hall Of The Fallen Angels

Where to Find the Whip: Directions Coming Soon!

Where to Find the Thorn Whip: Directions Coming Soon!

articles.title: All Blackstone Fragment Locations - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Blackstone Fragments are found all over Phantom Blade 0. Similar to Sha-Chi Amber Fragments, Blackstone Fragments are another currency used to upgrade your
articles.body:
Blackstone Fragments are found all over Phantom Blade 0. Similar to Sha-Chi Amber Fragments, Blackstone Fragments are another currency used to upgrade your abilities on the skill tree. You'll need four Blackstone Fragments to create a full Blackstone, so be sure to stay on the lookout for as many as you can find. Below you'll find all of the Blackstone Fragments in Phantom Blade 0, but if you're looking for a specific zone, just click on the name below to go right there.

Weeping Creek Valley Blackstone Fragment 1

Upon entering the Outpost you'll see a locked gate to your left. In order to access this room you'll need the Cell key , which you can get by exploring the house to the right of the Outpost Bell. Go up the stairs and drop out of the backside of the house.

You'll notice a glowing orange piece of loot on the ground, which is the Cell Key. Grab it and head back to the locked door to find the first Blackstone Fragment in Weeping Creek.

Weeping Creek Valley Blackstone Fragment 2

You'll get the next Blackstone Fragment from defeating a group of enemies just shy of the Sha-Chi Tower bridge. This is also the same spot you'll go to for the Purge the Sect Tale to grab the bow. Upon defeating all of the enemies in this area, you'll be granted the Blackstone Fragment.

Weeping Creek Valley Blackstone Fragment 3

Go right past the Long Pillar Overlook Bell, across the wooden bridge, and through the small little housing cluster with a few enemies. In the back right of the area, you'll see a waterfall and some enemies. Dispatch them and claim the purple glowing chest to find the second Blackstone Fragment inside.

Weeping Creek Valley Blackstone Fragment 4

From the Long Pillar Overlook, head left toward the Sha-Chi Tower. You'll be able to head in from the ground floor. Go straight, and on your right-hand side you'll see a Furnace bomb; instead, head left and fight the two enemies in your path. Follow the stairs up into the lower floor of the Sha-Chi Tower. You'll be faced with multiple Bronze Men you'll need to defeat. Once defeated, you'll be given the final Blackstone Fragment in Weeping Creek Valley.

Now you're ready to move on to the Crimson Forest for your next batch of Blackstone Fragments.

This page is still being worked on, and more will be updated soon.

Up Next: Weeping Creek Valley Blackstone Fragments

articles.title: HomePod Mini 2 first look: Three things I love and one disappointment
articles.summary: The new Mini is faster, quieter, and gorgeous in green, but its upgraded Mac speaker feature didn’t work for me.
articles.body: When I first heard about the new $149 HomePod Mini 2 at Apple’s Welcome Home event last month, I was disappointed. It’s been six years since Apple launched its entry-level smart speaker, and all it got in the second gen was a chip bump, some color glowy stuff, and better AirPlay? For $50 more than the original, which launched at $99, Apple didn’t even upgrade the sound system. It felt like the company phoned this one in. Now that I’ve got my hands on a couple and set them up in my home office, I’m more enthused. The Mini 2 is so much faster than the first-gen Mini, playing music in a few seconds and responding to smart home commands just as quickly. If you’re fed up with standing over your HomePod waiting for it to finally do what you asked, then that alone is worth the upgrade. Here are my three favorite features of the new Mini 2 after spending a couple days with it, and my one big disappointment. [Image: Siri is much snappier and much less chatty The biggest upgrade for the Mini 2 is Siri AI, but that isn’t available yet. Apple says it’s coming “later” in a software update. However, the basic smart voice assistant has definitely improved. Siri on the Mini 2 is much snappier than on the first-gen Mini, regularly responding in under three seconds. This is thanks to a newer, faster processor (the S10, up from the S5) and Wi-Fi 6E support (up from Wi-Fi 4). When I asked Siri to play Taylor Swift, a song started in a couple of seconds. It correctly told me who won this year’s World Series in under two seconds, and turned off the light or opened the shades in under three seconds. [Video: HomePod Mini2 vs Mini 1 smart home speed] That’s a huge improvement over the up to 10 seconds I often have to wait for Siri to get things done on the first-gen Mini. However, asking something harder, like who will win the US midterm elections, still brings up the familiar offer to look at some web results on my iPhone. As I said, Siri AI isn’t here yet. The other new behavior I am really enjoying is that when I ask Siri to perform a smart home action, such as open the shades or turn on the lights, instead of “OK, Jen,” or “One sec,” followed by a wordy confirmation of the action that I often get on the first-gen Mini, the Mini 2 just does it and doesn’t talk back. It’s not silent for every action, but it’s quiet enough to be a noticeable improvement. [Image: This Mini is gorgeous in green and sounds great The green color is divine. This is the prettiest small smart speaker I’ve seen — and I’ve tried them all. Yes, Amazon’s Echo Dot Max’s purple is fun, the Google Home Speaker’s pale green is elegant, but Apple’s deep green is seriously sophisticated. It’s a color that fits in really well in various places around my home, and I’m so glad the company finally released a green option. It’s a big improvement over the slightly garish yellow and orange of the prior-gen Minis and the best of the new colors. [Image: [Image: I saw all the colors in person at Apple’s Welcome Home event, and while the pink is pretty, it’s very pale, and the blue is functionally identical to the first-gen blue, maybe a shade lighter. While a lot of folks will be happy with black (don’t get white unless you plan to dust it regularly), the green is my new go-to. [Video: HomePod Mini 2 vs Mini 1 Sound Test] Two green HomePod Mini 2s look so good on the walnut Nanoleaf monitor stand I’m testing; it’s like my office got an instant upgrade. And while Apple didn’t update the speakers in the Mini 2, it’s still a very good speaker for its size, doing a fine job with Bad Bunny’s bass and delivering clear mids and vocals. While $300 is steep for computer speakers, two as a stereo pair in my office definitely delivered on room-filling sound. You can finally disable touch A few weeks ago I fumbled for my phone on my nightstand and accidentally hit the top of my HomePod Mini, blaring music in the bedroom at 3AM. My husband was not happy. [Image: [Image: A new setting in the Home app now lets you lock the Mini’s top controls. This goes for all HomePods, old and new, and it’s a major quality-of-life upgrade. How often do you intentionally touch the top of your HomePod? I bet far less often than accidentally! The other new trick for the top of the HomePod is Sound Glow. This makes the LEDs display colors that match the album art of the song you’re playing (it’s also backward compatible with the first-gen Mini and the second-gen HomePod). It’s neat, but only works with Apple Music and Podcasts and is so subtle that I don’t feel it adds much to my music-listening experience. [Image: A stereo pair of Minis sounds very good. Here they’re pictured on Nanoleaf’s new monitor stand, which has built-in LED lighting. Signature feature fail Beyond the speed improvement, the other new feature I was excited about is the HomePod Mini 2’s ability to be the default speaker for your Mac using what Apple calls “a responsive and persistent AirPlay connection.” This creates a wireless point-to-point connection between the computer and the HomePod. You can pair a single speaker or a stereo pair to your Mac, and the feature also works with the second-gen HomePod. (Two or four HomePod Mini 2s can also now be part of a surround sound setup using the new Apple TV 4K.) Disappointingly, I couldn’t get the Mac speaker set up to work. I have the required hardware: a Mac that supports Wi-Fi 6E, running the public release of macOS 27.2 (a Mac Mini M4), and HomePods on HomePod Software 27.2. But the Sound pane in my Mac’s settings didn’t offer an option to set a HomePod via AirPlay as the default sound output. [Product: Apple HomePod Mini 2 | The Mini showed up and connected like any other AirPlay speaker, with the same flaws as regular AirPlay — occasional artifacting, drop-offs, and some lag with notification sounds — along with the Mac defaulting to its built-in speakers when the computer restarts, or anytime I activate Siri on the HomePod. I also tried with a stereo pair of Minis, but they also played over regular AirPlay. According to a 9to5Mac’s hands-on, when the persistent AirPlay is enabled, the HomePod Mini should show up as a default system output device in the System Information, and there should be an option to enable it under “Play sound effects through” in the Sound pane in System Settings, but neither was there for me. I have seen other reports of the same issue. I tried resetting both HomePods completely after they updated to 27.2 out of the box (I was on the HomePod Software betas, but 27.2 is now in general release), and the feature still isn’t working. I reached out to Apple, but the company hasn’t responded to my requests yet; I’ll update this article if I hear back or find a solution. [Image: There’s more to come I’ve only been testing the Mini 2 for two days, and while the real test will come when it gets its Siri AI upgrade, the chip bump and speed improvements make this a bigger upgrade than it initially seemed. Apple does need to work on the Mac pairing feature; it has a lot of potential, but based on my struggles here, it feels unfinished. I plan to do a full review once Siri AI launches, and of course compare it to Apple’s big new smart home release: the upcoming $299 Apple HomeView smart display. It is also a Home hub, but the screen gives it more functionality. At $149, though, the Mini 2 is now the cheapest way to get an Apple Home hub with Thread and Matter support.

Nobody wants to bring a whip to a magic fight, so it's imperative that Rose Belmont books up on her spells and incantations on her journey to complete Castlevania: Belmont's Curse. Yes, it is very satisfying to tear through enemies with Vampire Killer, but you will absolutely need to power up your magic to survive, and that is where the handy Wise Heart Fragments come in. Dotted around the streets of Paris and beyond, these additional collectibles eventually give you more magical prowess, so here is the IGN guide covering exactly where to find Wise Heart Fragments in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse.

Location: Catacombs Of Paris: Throat of Hell

articles.title: Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal Swap Places for Halloween With Mister Fantastic and Doctor Doom Costumes
articles.summary: Halloween had no shortage of viral costumes, but Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal might have taken the crown by swapping places as Mister Fantastic and Doctor Doom.
articles.body:
Halloween had no shortage of viral costumes, but Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal might have taken the crown by swapping places as Mister Fantastic and Doctor Doom.

Downey Jr. set Marvel feeds on fire late last night when he posted video of him and Pascal sharing their night dressed as their characters in next month's Avengers: Doomsday . Instead of playing Victor von Doom, though, he dressed up in Reed Richards' retro-themed blue outfit, with Pascal dropping his superhero attire to sport Doom's iconic metal mask.

It looks like Downey put a bit more effort into his Halloween costume, considering Pascal is wearing jeans and a sweatshirt, but the effect is still there. Finding a convincing replacement for Doctor Doom's magical get-up probably would have been more trouble than it's worth anyway. You can see Downey's video below.

They're the variants no one expected to see, but still the ones they got this Halloween. With Doomsday now just weeks away, we'll likely only see its many, many stars taking to social media to spread the word.

That said, this was a tiny bit more than a cute marketing stunt. While it was fun to see the two team up for a quick costume swap, Downey and Pascal still took the time to hit the streets and greet trick-or-treaters. Pascal shared a video of him and the Doctor Doom actor out on the town, walking amongst the crowd, on his Instagram story .

If that wasn't evidence enough, X/Twitter user Patrick Oneill shared pictures of him and two children greeting them in full Star Wars attire. With one kid dressed up as Pascal's character, the Mandalorian, Downey reportedly made a joke about the encounter by inviting them to come meet the "real" Mandalorian.

Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal dressed up as Doctor Doom and Mister Fantastic for Halloween. 😭 — Drew Smith (@DrewDisneyDude) November 1, 2026

Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal dressed up as Doctor Doom and Mister Fantastic for Halloween. 😭

Avengers: Doomsday premieres December 18, 2026. When it marks the beginning of the end for this chapter of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, it will feature a cameo from Project Hail Mary's Sandra Hüller . It will also mark the final on-screen appearance of Sir Patrick Stewart . For more, you can check out how one recent poster highlighted Doctor Doom and his three Latverian witches .

articles.title: Hoyoverse’s Cozy Sim Petit Planet Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027
articles.body:
Rejoice, Nintendo Switch 2 owners with a taste for the cozy, because Hoyoverse, the studio behind Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail, is bringing its new intergalactic life sim Petit Planet to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. The free-to-play game is already releasing on PC, iOS, and Android on December 4, 2026, but it never hurts to have more cute and cozy content on your Switch.

The news came as part of a special update on the game from Hoyoverse, which also gave us a deep dive into some of the Petit Planet neighbors you can encounter, the home decor features, and some of the mini-games available as you live your life in Starsea. You start out taking care of your own planet, but can then explore the little islands in the skies around Starsea or visit the hub-style Galactic Bazaar for things like in-game auctions and community features.

Petit Planet was announced back in September 2025, and IGN got to play it a few months later , with our writer describing it as Animal Crossing meets The Little Prince.

"In my short time of about five hours with a preview of the closed beta, Petit Planet offered a charming, "The Little Prince"-themed take on Animal Crossing: New Horizons with an emphasis on clear progression and multiplayer. While these are two things some seemed to crave and were left empty in ACNH, the Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail studio may offer an answer – with potential caveats."

The special update also revealed a bunch of chances for players to score pre-registration prizes as well as a "Launch a Planet" event on the game's official website that starts today.

Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.

articles.title: Taika Waititi Blasts Critics as 'Irrelevant, Out of Touch, Obsolete' Following Klara and the Sun's Negative Reviews
articles.summary: Marvel filmmaker Taika Waititi has called critics "sad lost souls who couldn't achieve their dreams" after his latest film, Klara and the Sun, premiered with negative reviews.
articles.body:
Marvel filmmaker Taika Waititi has called critics "sad lost souls who couldn't achieve their dreams" after his latest film, Klara and the Sun , premiered with negative reviews.

The director behind projects like Jojo Rabbit and Thor: Love and Thunder unleashed his true feelings in a post on Instagram . Tied to an image shared by ScreenRant earlier this week that reflects audience reception to the live-action book adaptation, Waititi posted an emoji-filled message taking aim at the reviewers who walked away from his new movie unimpressed.

"I haven't read a review of anything aimed at me or my peers in almost 15 years," he said, along with a series of emojis. "But I do listen to the people."

Klara and the Sun's critical reception has struggled in the wake of its October 23, 2026, release date. While Rotten Tomatoes has recorded mostly positive reactions from viewers at 74% favorability, its Tomatometer has sunk to a 'rotten' 26%. Its IMDb Metascore is similarly dire at a negative 30 out of 100 after 27 reviews. IGN did not review the movie.

Waititi said he's strayed from reading reviews for years, but that didn't stop him from pointing his 2.8 million Instagram followers to those who didn't enjoy the story his Klara and the Sun was trying to tell.

"So, this Halloween, let's spare a thought for those sad lost souls who couldn't achieve their dreams of becoming artists, and thus settled, and became critics. The same people who also hated Jojo Rabbit," he added with a laughing-crying-face and shrug emoji.

Jojo Rabbit is Waititi's 2019 project and his first since turning heads with Thor: Ragnarok in 2017. The writer, director, actor, and producer suggested critics weren't fond of the World War II-era dark comedy, though what negative reaction he's referring to here isn't quite clear.

Jojo Rabbit boasts an impressive 81% critical rating on Rotten Tomatoes . Although its IMDb score isn't quite as high at a middling 58, some of the reviews listed there are extremely positive, including an A- from Entertainment Weekly and an 85 from The Wrap . IGN gave the film an 8.5/10 .

"Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home," an official description for the film from Sony Pictures said. "When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams) and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world."

While Waititi has had much to say about how critics have responded to Klara and the Sun, the films seems to have struggled to grab the attention of the average moviegoer, even if those who have seen it generally had a decent experience. According to Box Office Mojo , the movie adaptation of Kazuo Ishiguro's novel of the same name has only managed to pull in a dismal 1.7 million worldwide after two weekends in theaters.

Klara and the Sun was also expected to debut in around 2,000 theaters last week before Sony seemingly rolled back that plan with an 800-theater debut, per Collider . Deadline reported that the company chose to stop reporting box office earnings for the film this weekend, too, with its budget reportedly set somewhere around $20 million - $40 million.

Waititi signed off his Instagram post, saying, "Irrelevant. Out of touch. Obsolete. In the bin." He added a trash can emoji, a crying face emoji, and a heart hands emoji.

Waititi was previously set to helm a Star Wars movie , but after six years of attempting to get the film off the ground, he announced the project was "on ice" earlier this month. He once said his take on the universe was trying to "harness a little bit more of the fun from" the original trilogy . What's next for Klara and the Sun remains unclear.

Photo by Stephanie Augello/Variety via Getty Images.

articles.title: How to Unlock Pirate Shop Access - Free Item Shop Explained - Fortnite Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Fortnite is making almost everything in the Item Shop free for players for 14 days during the Treasure Hunters mini season - no, we're not kidding. There
articles.body:
Fortnite is making almost everything in the Item Shop free for players for 14 days during the Treasure Hunters mini season - no, we're not kidding. There is a catch, though: you need to find and unlock Pirate Shop Access to do so, and it is extremely rare. This IGN guide explains how to access the Pirate Shop in Fortnite so you can plunder it and get cosmetics like the One Piece skins, emotes, and more completely free without spending a single cent.

How to Unlock Pirate Shop Access in Fortnite

To unlock Pirate Shop Access and get Item Shop items for free in Fortnite, you must find a Pirate Shop Access Token during the Treasure Hunters mini season. It is a random drop when opening chests , and has an extremely rare drop rate - at the time of writing, we've only seen a handful of people with it.

Once you find a token, you won't miss it as a large "YOU FOUND PIRATE SHOP ACCESS" banner appears at the top of your screen, as shown in a screenshot taken from @snowslept's gameplay below.

If you're in a team, your teammates also unlock Pirate Shop Access, too!

How Pirate Shop Access Works in Fortnite

When you return to the lobby after the match is over, a screen appears, informing you that you've unlocked Pirate Shop Access. You get two tokens, meaning not only can you get unlimited free Item Shop items during the Treasure Hunters mini season, but also once more in 2027. They both last for two weeks each, allowing you to claim almost anything from the Fortnite Item Shop for 14 days, potentially giving you hundreds of dollars worth of free stuff.

The first token can be redeemed any time between November 1 and December 15, 2026 . This means that, if you find one, you can claim the One Piece collaboration skins for free. They typically cost 1,600 to 1,800 V-Bucks each.

It's not just skins, though - almost anything requires V-Bucks is yours for the taking, including emotes, Jam Tracks, and other cosmetics. Paid items, such as bundles that cost real currency rather than V-Bucks, are not included. You can buy Sidekicks you don't own, but only once.

To activate your Pirate Shop Access token, open the Fortnite Item Shop and you should see a "PLUNDER THE SHOP" banner in the bottom-left corner.

Click this (hold Right Stick Click on PlayStation, Right Stick Click on Xbox, Right Stick Click on Nintendo Switch) and a banner confirming you want to "START YOUR PLUNDERING!" appears. Click "ACTIVATE NOW" to start your 14-day window of free items.

If an item can be claimed, you'll see "FREE" next to it. Go to buy it like you would a typical purchase from the shop, but instead of having to front V-Bucks to get it, it's just added to your library for free. Heck yeah!

Note that free items are only for you - you cannot gift them to anyone else.

articles.title: Heat Director Michael Mann Hospitalized After Accidentally Shooting Himself in the Leg
articles.summary: Heat director Michael Mann was hospitalized with minor injuries after accidentally shooting himself in the leg at a Los Angeles gun range on Halloween.
articles.body:
Heat director Michael Mann was hospitalized with minor injuries after accidentally shooting himself in the leg at a Los Angeles gun range on Halloween.

TMZ confirmed the news with local authorities and the filmmaker's representative today. Mann was reportedly sent to the hospital for treatment and is in the process of being released.

"On Saturday, at a gun range, a weapon accidentally discharged while holstered resulting in a superficial injury to film director Michael Mann," his representative said this morning. "He was treated and is being released."

Mann is known for his role in developing some of the biggest crime dramas of the last 40 years and, as noted by TMZ, is a highly experienced target shooter himself. The site described the incident as having occurred during a training exercise of some kind, with its sources saying the 83-year-old director had no intention of harming himself. Additional details are unclear.

An ambulance ride to the hospital is probably not how Mann wanted to spend his Halloween in Los Angeles. While the accident took a bite out of his weekend, the filmmaker is currently putting the pieces of his long-awaited Heat follow-up together behind the scenes.

Our first big confirmation that the ball was rolling for Heat 2 arrived in February of this year when The Dark Knight star Christian Bale confirmed he was set to start filming the movie in Chicago soon. Inception's Leonardo DiCaprio boarded the project in July, with both he and Bale then reportedly said to play Chris Shiherlis and Vincent Hanna, respectively. Filming was expected to begin in November, this month, at the time.

Mann is also responsible for movies like Ferrari, Public Enemies, and Manhunter. Also expected to appear in Heat 2 are Adolescence's Stephen Graham and The Bear's Ebon Moss-Bachrach . Story details about the follow-up aren't completely clear, though we do know that it will have Mann's novel of the same name to lean on .

While we wait to hear more from Mann, you can check out IGN's 8/10 review of Heat's Blu-ray release. You can also read our 7/10 review of Ferrari.
